test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 14 March 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A can do 50% of a work in 20 days and B can do 66(2)/(3)% of the same work in 40 days. Both work together for 6 days. The remaining work is completed by C alone in 12 days. Working together, A, B and C will complete the same work in:
solution:
Given:

A completes the work alone = 40 days

B completes the work alone = 60 days

Both work together for 6 days. The remaining work is completed by C alone in 12 days.

Concept used:

Total work = Efficiency (Work done per hour) × Total time taken 

Calculation

LCM (40, 60) = 120

Let the total work be the individual time taken by the workers.

So, the total work = 120 units

The efficiency of A = 120/40 = 3 units

The efficiency of B = 120/60 = 2 units

Work done by A and B together in 6 days = (2 + 3) × 6 = 30 units

Remaining work = 120 - 30 = 90 units

The efficiency of C = 90/12 = 7.5 units

Work done each day by A, B, and C together

⇒ 3 + 2 + 7.5 = 12.5 units

Working together, A, B, and C will complete the same work in

⇒ 120/12.5 = 9(3)/(5) days

**∴ Working together, A, B, and C will complete the same work in 9(3)/(5) days.**
